name: tag_benchmark_ideas
description: A small dataset of proposed benchmark ideas for tagging and organizing math-related retrieval/QA tasks. It is intended to help categorize and evaluate models' ability to assign appropriate topic/tags or short labels to benchmark items and ideas. The data is largely meta-information for dataset/benchmark design rather than a standard predictive benchmark.
reputation: Niche, used primarily within the RAG4Math community and for internal benchmarking/idea organization rather than broad community adoption.
